461:t_1:4.en:
$$勝平$$
「Tokyo sure is a big city on either Earth!」

461:t_1:5.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Are you sure this is all right, $$勝平$$...? Leaving the $$クラッシャー隊$$ base without permission?」

461:t_1:6.en:
$$勝平$$
「Don't worry about it. Everyone's back in Japan for the first time in ages, and they've got things to do.」

461:t_1:7.en:
$$正太郎$$
「$n, $$甲児$$ and the Elements were talking about something for a long time...」

461:t_1:8.en:
$$勝平$$
「They're probably discussing special training to help Big Bro $n stop being the quiet type.」

461:t_1:9.en:
$$正太郎$$
「$$シンジ$$ and the other EVA pilots seemed to be in their own rooms, though...」

461:t_1:10.en:
$$勝平$$
「Sis $$葵$$ and the others are doing their own thing too, aren't they?」

461:t_1:11.en:
$$正太郎$$
「It seems to me that things between $$シンジ$$ and the others have changed...」

461:t_1:12.en:
$$勝平$$
「It's that puberty thing. That's what Big Bro $$桂$$ said.」

461:t_1:14.en:
$$勝平$$
「Forget about everyone else for now. I'm gonna enjoy my free time to the fullest!」

461:t_1:15.en:
$$正太郎$$
「But $$宇宙太$$ and $$恵子$$ are helping out at $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$.」

461:t_1:16.en:
$$勝平$$
「They used to be special employees, after all. They've probably got things to do.」

461:t_1:17.en:
$$正太郎$$
「You were one too, weren't you, $$勝平$$?」

461:t_1:18.en:
$$勝平$$
「You can say that, but I can't do invoice processing or anything.」

461:t_1:19.en:
$$勝平$$
「$$ワッ太$$ and the Executive and Managing Directors got called to $$２１世紀警備保障$$ HQ, so Big Bro $$木下$$ and the others have to handle the work.」

461:t_1:20.en:
$$正太郎$$
「To $$２１世紀警備保障$$...? What for...?」

461:t_1:23.en:
$$勝平$$
「But $$正太郎$$... You've been giving me grief all this time. What about you?」

461:t_1:24.en:
$$勝平$$
「Did you sneak out of $c for a secret date with $$マッキー$$?」

461:t_1:25.en:
$$正太郎$$
「...About that, $$勝平$$... Shouldn't we go our separate ways around here?」

461:t_1:27.en:
$$正太郎$$
「...Actually... Chief $$大塚$$ asked me to do something, and I'm in the middle of that mission.」

461:t_1:29.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Sorry. I can't tell you that.」

461:t_1:30.en:
$$勝平$$
「Don't be so uptight. If there's anything I can help with, I'll lend a hand.」

461:t_1:35.en:
$$正太郎$$
「$$梅本$$... You knew I was following you?」

461:t_1:36.en:
$$梅本$$
「I'm quite used to being pursued.」

461:t_1:37.en:
$$勝平$$
「Your mission was to follow Uncle $$梅本$$, $$正太郎$$?!」

461:t_1:38.en:
$$梅本$$
「I imagine Chief $$大塚$$ asked you to do it.」

461:t_1:39.en:
$$正太郎$$
「...I'm sorry, $$梅本$$. You've helped us so many times, yet I've acted as though I suspect you.」

461:t_1:40.en:
$$梅本$$
「Don't worry about it. I'm the one at fault for contacting the Federation Army while hiding my identity.」

461:t_1:41.en:
$$梅本$$
「As a commander, it is perfectly natural for him to be suspicious of me.」

461:t_1:44.en:
$$梅本$$
「If I were an agent of evil, $$勝平$$ would surely be sad...」

461:t_1:45.en:
$$梅本$$
「I respect you for trying to carry out this mission alone with that in mind.」

461:t_1:47.en:
$$梅本$$
「I have done what I needed to do... Now I have entrusted everything to you and $$ワッ太$$, so I have nothing left to hide.」

461:t_1:48.en:
$$梅本$$
「I would like you to listen to a story from my past.」

461:t_1:50.en:
$$梅本$$
「Yes... A story of a home I will never return to.」

461:t_1:54.en:
$$梅本$$
「...Earth's seas are beautiful. Both the blue seas and the green seas are wonderful.」

461:t_1:55.en:
$$勝平$$
「Uncle... I heard you went to $$翠の地球$$ and met Big Bro $$イチ$$ and the others while I was away.」

461:t_1:56.en:
$$梅本$$
「$$一太郎$$... If he keeps growing as he has, he'll make a fine engineer.」

461:t_1:57.en:
$$正太郎$$
「...$$梅本$$. I hear you've helped Earth's forces in various places since the Empire attacked.」

461:t_1:58.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I hear most of that help has been sharing technology, but that it comes from technology different from Earth's.」

461:t_1:60.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Chief $$大塚$$ of the Far East Branch is very grateful to you, $$梅本$$.」

461:t_1:61.en:
$$正太郎$$
「But since you won't tell us anything about yourself, he became concerned...」

461:t_1:62.en:
$$梅本$$
「As I said earlier, I have no intention of blaming Chief $$大塚$$.」

461:t_1:63.en:
$$正太郎$$
「...Then I'll ask. $$梅本$$... Are you not from Earth?」

461:t_1:65.en:
$$梅本$$
「My real name is $$ナバロン$$... I am a human from $$ガバール星$$.」

461:t_1:67.en:
$$梅本$$
「$$ガバール星$$ is a nation of robots ruled by the mother computer, $$シグマ$$.」

461:t_1:68.en:
$$梅本$$
「There, I researched day and night to build powerful robots.」

461:t_1:69.en:
$$梅本$$
「But I grew disgusted with what I was doing, and fled $$ガバール星$$.」

461:t_1:71.en:
$$梅本$$
「$$シグマ$$ ordered us to build powerful combat robots. The robots we developed were used to invade other planets.」

461:t_1:72.en:
$$梅本$$
「But I wanted to build more than mere weapons. I... wanted to build a real robot.」

461:t_1:75.en:
$$梅本$$
「When I escaped from $$ガバール星$$, I had only a vague image in my mind...」

461:t_1:76.en:
$$梅本$$
「It took shape only after I met $$竹尾道太郎$$ here on Earth.」

461:t_1:78.en:
$$梅本$$
「He saved me after I had an accident in space, and gave me the name $$梅本$$ so I could live on Earth.」

461:t_1:79.en:
$$梅本$$
「To repay his kindness, I developed a robot.」

461:t_1:81.en:
$$梅本$$
「$$竹尾$$ said he would use a robot to start a business doing odd jobs. I thought it would help him.」

461:t_1:82.en:
$$勝平$$
「So $$トライダー$$ is that 'real robot' you were talking about, Uncle?」

461:t_1:83.en:
$$梅本$$
「That wasn't my intention while I was building it. But when I saw $$竹尾$$'s joy at the completed $$トライダー$$...」

461:t_1:84.en:
$$梅本$$
「And when I saw his son, $$ワッ太$$, I became certain I had built a real robot.」

461:t_1:85.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Just what do you mean by a real robot?」
